defs.def: a game in which players roll heavy balls (called bowls ) along a special track towards a group of pins (= bottle-shaped objects) and try to knock over as many of them as possible 保龄球

ex.s: Many enjoy 3_________table tennis or 4________bowling, while there were lots of people 5________badminton, and many like to 6________golf.
ex.t: 许多人喜欢 3____ 乒乓球或 4____ 保龄球，而当时有很多人在 5____ 羽毛球，许多人喜欢 6____ 高尔夫。

ex.s: Rock climbing, bowling, watching comedies, and playing basketball were the things I thought of doing instead.
ex.t: 攀岩、打保龄球、看喜剧和打篮球，是我当时想做的事。

ex.s: Do something you really like—to ride a skateboard, go bowling, or watch a comedy—whatever stimulates your mind and makes you feel happy.
ex.t: 做一件你真正喜欢的事——玩滑板、去打保龄球，或看一出喜剧——任何能激发思绪、让你开心的事。

ex.s: Other sports that some people would like to see included are wushu, competitive dancing and bowling.
ex.t: 一些人希望被列入的其他运动项目有武术、竞技舞蹈和保龄球。

ex.s: I also did some temporary work for several local sporting events, like the bowling tournament.
ex.t: 我还为几场本地体育赛事做过临时工作，比如保龄球锦标赛。
